# RAV (Rive Animation Viewer) - llms-full.txt

canonical_url: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/
owner: IVG Design
last_updated: 2026-08-22
language: en
site_type: product-marketing + technical documentation

## 1) Product Definition
RAV (Rive Animation Viewer) is a desktop tool for loading and inspecting Rive (.riv) animations outside the Rive editor. Version 2.5.1 is the current public release and is available through the normal public updater feed.

## 2) Primary Entities
- RAV: SoftwareApplication / DeveloperApplication
- IVG Design: Organization (publisher)
- Rive (.riv): supported animation file format
- ViewModel: structured input model surfaced in RAV control panels

## 3) Canonical URL Set
- Home: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/
- Documentation: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs
- Changelog: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/changelog
- Privacy and anonymous usage counting: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/privacy

## 4) Feature Facts with Evidence
- Auto-generated ViewModel controls: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#viewmodel-controls
- Dynamic ViewModel lists use a direct authored instance name when exposed or one unique match between a readable string property and the definition's canonical instance-name set. Ambiguous or missing matches fall back to `Row N`; generic `viewModelName` identifiers are never presented as authored row names. MCP paths remain zero-based: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/viewmodel-controls
- Each image property uses one full-width select containing every embedded raster asset followed by `Open file…` and `Clear`; `Open file…` invokes a hidden file input, with no separate folder/Clear buttons and no `Embedded image…` placeholder. Catalog entries use `uniqueFilename` identity, magic-byte MIME detection, and numbered duplicate labels. Non-raster embedded resources stay outside the image catalog, and standalone exports preserve the same catalog and control: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/viewmodel-controls
- Event log with source filtering: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#event-console
- Script REPL and runtime inspection commands: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#script-console
- Canvas backgrounds and standalone export: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#configuration
- Standalone self-contained export: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#standalone-export
- Applied editor config and lifecycle callbacks are embedded and executed in standalone exports: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/script-editor
- macOS .riv declarations cover UTI `app.rive.editor.rive-file` and compatibility UTI `app.rive.animation.viewer.riv`, both with the document-icon resource, Viewer role, Alternate rank, and version/schema-gated post-update Launch Services refresh without default takeover: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/opening-files
- Windows NSIS and MSI packages ship a dedicated ten-resolution `RiveFileIcon.ico`. NSIS rewrites the generated `Rive File` document-icon value on install/update, preserves the association that preceded RAV for uninstall, and notifies Explorer; MSI owns the equivalent value as an upgrade-aware removable component: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/opening-files
- RAV defaults to Latest (auto), preserves explicit runtime pins, and falls back to 2.39.2 if discovery is unavailable. Web 2.40.0 / runtime-v0.1.271 retains its proven nested, data-bound image warning in both WebGL2 and Canvas: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/configuration
- RAV 2.5.1 keeps playback-surface controls synchronized after a file opens and restores Reset/Default playback in place. Fixed size is the canvas viewport, not the authored artboard; `Contain` can only align along an axis with unused canvas space: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/ui-layout
- RAV 2.5.0 places playback in a dedicated child WebView while controls and diagnostics remain in the main WebView, reducing ordinary UI contention with playback: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/changelog
- Configured official builds enable Anonymous Usage by default, show a first-run notice before reporting, and keep the opt-out in Settings: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/privacy
- Configuration, renderer, and layout controls: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#configuration
- MCP bridge health and recent-command activity states: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/mcp
- Keyboard shortcut reference: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#keyboard-shortcuts
